evidence.section: Experimental procedures
evidence.quote: A 20 mm-thick high-entropy alloy ingot containing 50 Fe, 30 Mn, 10 Co and 10 Cr (at%) was prepared using a vacuum induction melting furnace.

evidence.section: Experimental procedures
evidence.quote: The ingot was subjected to multi-pass hot rolling to 5 mm. The initial and finish rolling temperature was 1130 ◦C and 1020 ◦C, respectively.

evidence.section: Experimental procedures
evidence.quote: After that, the hot rolled band was annealed at 1100 ◦C for 1 h followed by water-quenching.

evidence.section: Experimental procedures
evidence.quote: The annealed hot band was further processed to 0.80 mm by two-stage cold rolling involving first cold rolling reduction of 60 %.

evidence.section: Experimental procedures
evidence.quote: the first cold rolled sheets were subjected to intermediate annealing at 700 ◦C (Route A, Material A), 900 ◦C (Route B, Material B) and 1000 ◦C (Route C, Material C) for 8 min

evidence.section: 3.1. Microstructure of the annealed hot band and first cold-rolled sheet
evidence.quote: The HCP phase accounts for 26.9 % of the total volume. The FCC phase exhibit equiaxed grains with an average grain size of approximately 45.7 μm. Within these FCC grains, lath-shaped HCP phase structures of thickness ranging from 4 to 6 μm are observed.

evidence.section: 3.1. Microstructure of the annealed hot band and first cold-rolled sheet
evidence.quote: The fraction of HCP phase increases to ~84.5 %

evidence.quote: The sample exhibits a single FCC phase

evidence.quote: besides the FCC phase, ~ 3.5 % of the recrystallized microstructure is characterized by lath HCP phase

evidence.quote: the content of HCP phase increases to ~8 %

evidence.section: 3.2. Microstructure after intermediate annealing at different temperatures
evidence.quote: At 700 ◦C annealing, the majority of the deformed structure is replaced by fine recrystallized grains, with an average grain size of approximately 0.67 μm.

evidence.quote: numerous annealing twins are formed within the recrystallized grains

evidence.section: 3.2. Microstructure after intermediate annealing at different temperatures
evidence.quote: Here, the content of twins is lower than that in the sample annealed at 700 ◦C.
